'''''Donol''''' was a [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Shortly before the [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|destruction of the ''Scythe'' convoy]], it departed the cruiser [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] with commandos on board. It and its two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] escorts entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], bound for parts unknown.
